dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: Thin, low-contrast pale fringes visible on the greater and median coverts, forming repetitive fine lines rather than thick distinct bands.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: High boundary sharpness; thin pale edges are clearly visible along the margins of the folded primary and secondary feathers against the darker feather bodies.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Diffuse; the dark base color and pale scalloped pattern transition continuously from the crown to the mantle with no distinct linear boundary.

other_distinctive_markers: Uniform distribution of pale-edged feathers across the dorsal surface creates a high-frequency scaly macro-pattern.
